important_discussion_points: Supply events missing in Kibana for Manhattan Non Yeti VR2.9 FW 2440A during Darwin2.0 testing
DataOS confirmed non-Yeti events flowing at OpenSearch, issue likely not reaching DataOS from Stratus
Triage call identified missing Jarvis event causing Telemetry & CDM filters not to generate
Issue reproduced with latest FW version 2446B, supply events still missing
No events received for UUID 68602636-938a-4b3b-885b-213611ae00c7 confirmed by Satish Kumar
tickets.comment_summary: Investigation confirmed supply events missing in Kibana for Manhattan Non Yeti devices. Root cause identified as missing Jarvis event preventing Telemetry & CDM filter generation. Issue persists across multiple firmware versions and requires HP Smart app to push missing Jarvis events for successful CDM onboarding over USB.

important_discussion_points: MMK printer family reporting ink_inserted_hp_<color> as 0 due to suppliesYield unit reporting in microliters instead of milliliters
DST/BDIS uses ink_inserted_hp_total to filter printers, exception added for CDM printers as workaround
Investigation confirmed multiple active FW versions across Manhattan and Malbec reporting suppliesYield in microliters
Issue affects downstream supply count calculations causing values to resolve to 0 in PSU conversion
Firmware team confirmed fix requires schema changes and magnitude adjustment (dividing by 1,000)
tickets.comment_summary: Root cause identified as MMK firmware incorrectly reporting suppliesYield values in microliters instead of expected milliliters. This causes downstream PSU conversion to round values to 0, impacting ink_inserted_hp calculations for DST/BDIS. Investigation shows issue present across multiple firmware versions since VR5.1, requiring firmware fix with schema changes and unit conversion adjustments.

important_discussion_points: Issue related to TASSEL and LEBI platforms requiring tracking under LOWINKFW team/project

tickets.comment_summary: Ticket routing issue resolved by cloning to appropriate LOWINKFW project (LOWINKFW-15205) since SRFWBUG is intended for SoL-related issues and this involves TASSEL/LEBI platforms.
